statement: Float32 implicit patches produce essentially identical logits and 100% greedy token agreement, while the standard bfloat16 implementation produces 87.5% agreement.

protocol.update: exact low-rank gate/up patch action plus direct RMSNorm-scale patch, with a bounded explicit W+delta_W conformance check

verdict_rule.VERIFIED: All fidelity gates pass, float32 agreement is 1.0, float32 maximum logit L-infinity is <= 0.001, and bfloat16 agreement is exactly 0.875.
verdict_rule.FALSIFIED: All fidelity gates pass and either float32 violates its exact contract or bfloat16 agreement differs from 0.875.
verdict_rule.BLOCKED: Any fidelity or evidence-integrity gate fails.
